headline: Indian markets eye Diwali gains as Nifty reclaims 23,000; corporate earnings and global oil supply in focus

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Nifty reclaimed the 23,000 level and Sensex gained 308 points in the most recent trading session
Investors are anticipating a potential Diwali bonanza during the trading week of November 2-6
OPEC+ has decided to maintain oil output targets despite disruptions caused by the Iran war
A significant number of companies are scheduled to report their Q2 quarterly results today, November 2
whatHappening: Punjab National Bank has implemented a hike in its MCLR across select tenures
Affle 3i is set to acquire Israel's Perion Network in an all-cash deal worth $420 million
Yes Bank has rejected allegations of non-compliance following a Supreme Court verdict regarding AT-1 bonds
The CBI has extradited a key accused in the Rs 6,000-crore Mahadev betting app case from Oman
summary: Indian markets start the week of November 2 on a positive note as Nifty reclaims the 23,000 mark. Investors are focused on Q2 earnings reports and the upcoming Diwali season for market direction. Key corporate developments include PNB's lending rate hike and Affle's $420 million international acquisition.
